device.description: 8-bit 40 us microprocessor-compatible SAR ADC with 8-channel multiplexer, MUX address on the data bus
device.note: adc0848.pdf (SNAS523D) p.2 connection diagram (Figure 1 PLCC), p.3 operating conditions and digital DC characteristics, p.4 AC characteristics (tC, tACC, t1H/t0H, tWI/tRI), p.7 timing diagrams, p.9 functional description, p.11 Table 2 ADC0848 MUX addressing

registers.name: MUX
registers.note: internal MUX address latch MA4-MA0 (loaded on the WR rising edge with RD high); no read-back; power-on value not documented

commands.name: Load MUX address and start conversion (CS and WR low, RD high; latched on WR rising)
commands.note: Table 2: MA3 = 0 differential pairs CH1/2, CH3/4, CH5/6, CH7/8; MA4 MA3 = 0 1 single-ended to AGND; 1 1 pseudo-differential to CH8. In every mode the + input is CH(MA2..MA0 + 1), so the channel index is MA2..MA0

pages: p.2 (Figure 1 PLCC pinout), p.3 (operating conditions: VCC 4.5-6.0 V; VIN(1) 2.0 V, VIN(0) 0.8 V), p.4 (tC 40 us tested / 60 us design limit, tACC 225 ns, t1H/t0H 200 ns, tWI/tRI 400 ns, tW(WR) 150 ns), p.7 (Figure 11), p.9 (functional description: WR rising with RD high latches MA0-MA4 and starts; INTR low at completion; CS and RD low reset INTR and output the result), p.11 (Table 2)
notModeled: analog inputs, multiplexer modes and VREF span (stored only; the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
the conversion time is set by the internal clock (30 us typ, 40 us tested, 60 us design limit); the model uses 60 us
RD held low during the whole WR low period keeps the previous MUX configuration (Table 2 last row) and outputs the previous result; the model always latches the data-bus bits as the MUX address
INTR is reset by the WR falling edge (tWI 400 ns); the model clears it at the start (WR rising) or on a read (tRI 400 ns not modeled); a read must come 600 ns after INTR asserts
MUX address codes MA4..MA0 = 1 1 1 1 1 (pseudo-differential CH8 against itself) are not listed in Table 2
logic control inputs tolerate up to 15 V (absolute maximum only; no operating range is given above VCC)
the ADC0848 is obsolete (every orderable part in the addendum)
variants: ADC0844 shares the datasheet (4 channels, 20-pin PDIP, MUX address MA0-MA3; not in the skeleton). The 28-pin PDIP has a different numbering and no orderable part.
